items.title: Santo Pecora Interview, 1972-11-09
items.q: That's George Apprentice. So he left, see, before I had time to talk to him.

ctx.x: You didn't know him? You look so different?

He's changed so much and he kept waving at me and I said, howdy, howdy, that's it. And, uh, when I got off the stand, he said, you know who's sitting by the bar? That's George Apprentice. So he left, see, before
